note: All identifiers are synthetic. The invalid set deliberately includes the PHI-shaped mistakes (payload-in-event, attrs-clear-text-mrn, attrs-hmac-not-fixed-length-hex, attrs-free-text-value, claim-check-presigned-url) so a regression cannot reintroduce them quietly. Keep these asserted, never skipped.

valid.note: Deliberate drop: status dropped, no error code
Failed attempt with a code and a redacted message
Step failure routed to the DLQ
Blocking retry paused a partition; triggering message id included
Partition resumed; duration_ms is the outage length

invalid.violates: partition_paused is not a message stage
ts must be an RFC 3339 UTC string, not an epoch float
additionalProperties: no payload field exists; payload bytes must never enter _tb.events (invariant 6)
attrs key must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}$ (this one fails on casing and the hyphen only; see attrs-clear-text-mrn for the PHI rule)
attrs key 'mrn' denotes a direct identifier and is rejected in clear form; it is admissible only as 'mrn_hmac'
an _hmac-suffixed value must be exactly 64 hex characters, so a clear-text value cannot hide behind the suffix
non-hashed attrs values are short codes: no spaces, 64 characters max, which rejects free text that can carry PHI
claim_check must not contain a query string; a presigned URL becomes a stored, replayable credential in ClickHouse and the browser
stage enum: 'enriched' is a pipeline step name, not a lifecycle stage
